title: Composition-stable dimension-3 no-go
theorem: If allowed finite Hilbert-space dimensions are closed under independent tensor composition and contain d>1, then they contain d^k for every k>=1. Therefore no singleton {d} with d>1, in particular {3}, is tensor-composition closed.
surviving_reinterpretation: Dimension three may still label an elementary/indecomposable system type, but tensor closure alone cannot select the elementary prime: p=2,3,5,7,11 all generate the same kind of composition-closed power family.
prior_art_boundary: Composite-system capacity multiplication/information locality is standard in operational reconstructions; this is a consistency no-go rather than a historical novelty claim.
